description: This file contains utility functions for managing Azure Queue streams within the Orleans streaming infrastructure, including generating queue names, deleting queues, and clearing messages.

classes.name: AzureQueueStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for Azure Queue stream management, such as generating queue names, deleting, and clearing queues.

methods.name: GenerateDefaultAzureQueueNames
methods.description: Generates default Azure Queue names based on a service ID and provider name.

methods.name: DeleteAllUsedAzureQueues
methods.description: Deletes all specified Azure queues; overloads handle connection string or options.

methods.name: ClearAllUsedAzureQueues
methods.description: Clears all messages in specified Azure queues; overloads handle connection string or options.
